decisions.decision: The board agreed to lift the cease and desist order on the outdoor wood fired burner at 245 West Street for a limited time, to ascertain whether the air pollution problem had been solved. Any move of the burner, raising of the stack or trimming of trees requires a request to Agent Jim Garreffi for approval, and Garreffi is to be present when the burner is lit.
